title: MIA PARITY MASTER AUDIT — canonical core, transcript/context, product integrity, Clean Nails->Neurotin, Option C eval (read-only, no implementation)
description: Second-phase read-only parity master audit. Determine with code+data evidence how Simulator = Web Chat = WhatsApp can share identical semantic MIA behavior (intent, conversation state, context, product selection, response, sale/cancel events, media selection, media dispatch), diverging only where transport/presentation strictly requires. Investigate: (1) entry points and where they diverge; (2) whether a canonical shared core exists, else minimal design for MIA Core -> Semantic Decision -> Channel Adapter; (3) transcript/context (messages, conversation, customer, sales state, cancellation, product, knowledge/catalog) including the BUG in process.ts that reads OLD messages instead of RECENT (order by created_at asc limit 20 returns oldest), correct context contract; (4) product integrity for the Clean Nails->Neurotin incident (user intent -> product resolution -> selected product -> response -> media selection -> media dispatch), all possible causes and which is PROVEN, define invariant DISPATCHED_MEDIA.product_id === SELECTED_PRODUCT.id and where/how to enforce+test; (5) channel parity matrix (product question, purchase, confirmation, cancellation, post-sale, ambiguous product, media, new purchase after sale) with file+line+cause; (6) classify each divergence as BUSINESS LOGIC (-> core) / PRESENTATION (per-channel) / TRANSPORT (per-channel) / BUG (fix) / SOURCE OF TRUTH (decision), especially channel branches; (7) outbound/dispatch audit (text/images/audio/video/media ids/product ids/retries/ordering/Baileys/Web Chat/Simulator) - does any adapter modify semantics; (8) parity test strategy (canonical scenarios run against 3 channels, compare intent/state/selected product/response strategy/text/events/media product_id/outbound payload), NOT implemented. Priority: Clean Nails->Neurotin, two entry points, context/transcript divergence, cancellation, post-SALE_WON, media dispatch, rest. Evaluate Option C (Shared MIA Core) against current state and minimal alternative, choose by evidence not preference. LOOP RULE: READ-ONLY. No code/DB/migrations/commits/deploy/no data-writing E2E. Document bugs, keep investigating. Deliverable: single report + LOOP TERMINATION REPORT, state MISSION_COMPLETE then STOP_FOR_HUMAN.
